rules.title: Berkeley rent control coverage by unit type
rules.requirement: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 are fully covered by rent control; new construction, most condos and later single-family tenancies are only partially covered and have no rent control.
rules.key_value: rent control covers most multifamily built before 1980
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered: pre-1980 multifamily, single-family tenancies before 1996, rooming houses
rules.exemptions: Exempt: golden duplex, shared kitchen or bath with owner, ADU with owner-occupancy, university units, nonprofit cooperatives
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

any.unavailable: single-family home with tenancy that began before 1996, or rooming house with five or more rooms rented individually

exempt_if.unavailable: exempt unit types (golden duplex, owner shares kitchen or bath, ADU with owner-occupancy, university unit, nonprofit cooperative)

rules.title: Berkeley just cause coverage by unit type
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to fully and partially covered units; exempt unit types have no just cause protection.
rules.key_value: just cause applies to fully and partially covered units
rules.exemptions: Exempt unit types listed in the coverage guide
rules.quoted_span: Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes

exempt_if.unavailable: exempt unit types (golden duplex, owner shares kitchen or bath, ADU with owner-occupancy, university unit, nonprofit cooperative)

notes: Coverage table is a guide only; new construction is stated as certificate of occupancy after June 1980 here vs after 1980 on D006, so the pre-1980 year cutoff is approximate.
